description: Get usage instructions for a named Semiotic theme preset. Returns ThemeProvider examples, CSS custom properties, and design token export patterns. Available themes: light, dark, high-contrast, pastels, pastels-dark, bi-tool, bi-tool-dark, italian, italian-dark, tufte, tufte-dark, journalist, journalist-dark, playful, playful-dark, carbon, carbon-dark.

name.description: Theme preset name, e.g. 'tufte', 'pastels-dark', 'bi-tool'. Omit to list all available themes.

name: applyTheme
